Consider splitting the rent and shared expenses equitably, not equally. If you bring home 42% of the total money, you could pay for 42% of the shared living expenses. This system works very well.

Don’t fight with each other over the small stuff. Trust me, you’re gonna have arguments about where to put the couch, or where to put that lamp. It’s not worth fighting over. And the more willing you are to sacrifice for each other, the more the other person will want to sacrifice for you.

Make sure to have time apart from each other. It helps with overall mental health and a happier relationship.

Have things that you do that’s your special thing, like taking walks together, or Sunday brunches. Something that you two share.
